headline: Google launches TPU 8tx and 8i Max chips for AI agents
dek: The chips double capacity and add security, per Canaltech.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Two new chips
body: Google Cloud announced the TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max AI chips, per Canaltech and Tecmundo.
They extend the 8th-generation TPU line unveiled in April (Tecmundo).

points.t: Protects data and model weights in the hardware.
Half the latency of the TPU 8t (Tecmundo).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: TPU 8i Max
body: The chip was built to remove memory bottlenecks in AI agents, per Canaltech and Tecmundo.
It doubles the compute, SRAM and memory bandwidth of the TPU 8i (Tecmundo).

stat.cap: the capacity of the TPU 8i, says Tecmundo

items.t: About 100 customers already use Google TPUs (Tecmundo).

caption.hook: Google launched the TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, new chips for the era of AI agents.
body: Per Canaltech and Tecmundo, the TPU 8tx was designed to keep sensitive data and model weights isolated even during use, with security built into the hardware. It uses custom AMD CPU hosts and has half the latency of the TPU 8t.

The TPU 8i Max was built to remove memory bottlenecks in AI agents and doubles the compute, SRAM and memory bandwidth of the TPU 8i. Tecmundo reports that about 100 customers already use Google TPUs. The sources gave no pricing or general availability date for the new chips.
caption.cta: Will custom chips decide the AI agent race?
